g.text: ESP32 + 4-channel 5V optocoupler relay board + 24VAC irrigation valves
1. Control Side: ESP32 To Relay Inputs
Do not power the relay board from ESP32 3V3
2. Power Side: Transformer To Relay Contacts To Valves
Typical board silk is often NC-COM-NO per channel. Match your board labels and only wire COM + NO.
Each row is one full switched 24VAC valve circuit.
Switch ON in ESPHome/Home Assistant should energize the matching relay. Switch OFF should release it. All relays should remain OFF during boot.
